Subject: Opal Health POC follow-up: success criteria & next steps

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we scope the infra: 

What we heard (summary):
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for clinical triage summarization and routing for high-priority outpatient referrals.
- Success criteria (what Opal will validate): average end-to-end latency under 600ms for 512-token requests, >92% accuracy on gold eval set for classification labels, and acceptable hallucination rate (<1%).
- Data: subset of 50k de-identified referral notes for the 2-week POC.

Ask from Redwood: please confirm concurrent user estimate (QPS) and expected peak burst cadence. That will determine reserved GPU sizing and autoscale policy.

Proposed POC timeline:
- Week 0: NDA & data ingestion prep (1–3 business days after NDA)
- Week 1: Baseline model runs, initial evals, tweak prompts
- Week 2: Iteration, A/B tests on quantized model variant, handover and ops runbook

Next steps:
1) Confirm expected concurrency and burst windows (example: batch of 150 concurrent requests during mornings).
2) Provide procurement contact if we should route contract/PO.
3) Accept preliminary infra plan from our infra team (I will loop them in).

Attached: opal_poc_success_criteria.pdf (recap), capacity_estimate_template.xlsx

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Opal Health POC follow-up — infra proposal (baseline + burst)

Hi all — draft infra recommendation below (high level). Attached: capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx and runbook-autoscale.md.

Short summary: we can hit Opal's targets using a hybrid approach — small reserved footprint for baseline and autoscale to temporary burst capacity in the same region. Proposal: 

1) Reserved baseline: 2 x A10G (dedicated) with continuous batching enabled. This handles steady 15 QPS with p95 ~220–320ms depending on prompt length.
2) Burst strategy: autoscale out to 4 additional A10G instances (total 6) using warm pool spin-up. Warm pool: maintain 1 warm spare worker (cold-start mitigation). Autoscale trigger: CPU/GPU utilization >60% AND queue latency >150ms for 30s. Scale step: +2 GPUs, cooldown 90s, max scale target 6 GPUs. Expected spin-up to warm pool node: ~45–60s; to full warm node ~90–120s.
3) Model variant: recommend 7B int8 quantized model variant for POC to balance latency and quality; keep full-precision for final eval if needed. Cache prefixes for repeated prompt scaffolding to cut token compute ~12–20%.
4) Throughput tactics: increase batch window to 25ms during bursts, continuous KV cache enabled. Use request hedging to limit p95 spikes.
5) Cost/estimate: baseline reserved (2 x A10G) + occasional 4-node burst for ~45 mins/day predicts ~18–22 GPU-hours/day. See attached spreadsheet for hourly estimate.
6) On-call / escalation: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com) primary during business hours; Dev Patel escalation for overnight.

I'll iterate if they ask for lower-latency config (p95 <=500ms) — we'd recommend larger GPUs or model pruning.

Dev
Principal Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference

Sofia / Tom — thanks for the quick replies. Per our internal infra run, here is the proposed POC plan and immediate next steps: 

POC infrastructure (proposed):
- Reserved baseline: 2 x A10G (dedicated) with continuous batching
- Autoscale: warm pool + scale to max 4 additional A10G (total 6) during bursts. Autoscale triggers and cooldowns as defined in the attached runbook.
- Model: 7B int8 quantized variant for primary run; full-precision model available for final eval if needed.

Operational timeline:
- Tue (EOD): NDA signed and drive link with 50k notes delivered
- Wed: Data ingest + initial baseline runs (Dev leads)
- Thu–Fri: Iterations on prompts + quantized variant evaluation
- Following Mon: Final comparison and POC sign-off (Ops handover)

Owners and contacts:
- POC owner (Redwood): Laura Bennett (solutions)
- Infra/ops: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com), Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com) — Marcus primary POC on-call
- Success criteria verification: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
